I'm working on the experiment page sidebar navigation in MLflow and I've noticed that time range filter parameters get dropped when switching between certain tabs.

*   When navigating between traces-related tabs (such as Overview, Sessions, Traces, and Chat Sessions), the sidebar navigation links must preserve ALL current URL query parameters in their href, including both time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel, startTime) and traces-specific parameters (e.g. selectedTraceId).

*   When navigating from a traces-related tab to a non-traces-related tab (such as Datasets), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include traces-specific parameters (e.g. selectedTraceId).

*   When navigating from a non-traces-related tab to a traces-related tab (such as Traces), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include tab-specific parameters (e.g. selectedDatasetId).

*   When navigating between non-traces-related tabs (e.g. from Datasets to Judges), the navigation link href must include time range parameters (e.g. startTimeLabel) from the current URL but must NOT include any other tab-specific parameters (e.g. selectedDatasetId, viewMode).

*   Time range parameters that qualify for cross-tab preservation include at minimum startTimeLabel and startTime; all other non-time-range parameters are considered tab-specific and must be dropped when navigating outside their applicable tab group.


**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.
I'll start by exploring the codebase to find the sidebar navigation code for the experiment page.

All the old `preserveQueryParams` logic has been replaced. My implementation is complete.

## Summary

The bug was in the experiment page sidebar navigation: it preserved the **entire** URL query string only when navigating between two traces-related tabs, and dropped **all** params otherwise — including the time-range filter params (`startTimeLabel`, `startTime`) that should carry across every tab.

### Changes

**1. `experiment-page-tabs/side-nav/utils.tsx`** — Added a `getSideNavLinkSearch(currentSearch, activeTab, targetTab)` helper and a `TIME_RANGE_QUERY_PARAM_KEYS` constant (`startTimeLabel`, `startTime`, `endTime`). The logic:
- **Traces tab → traces tab**: preserve the whole search string (all params, incl. `selectedTraceId`).
- **Any nav involving a non-traces tab**: keep only the time-range params, dropping every other tab-specific param (`selectedTraceId`, `selectedDatasetId`, `viewMode`, …).

**2. `ExperimentPageSideNavSection.tsx`** (the in-page side nav) — replaced the inline `preserveQueryParams` logic with `getSideNavLinkSearch(...)`.

**3. `common/components/MlflowSidebarExperimentItems.tsx`** (the global left sidebar's nested experiment items) — this component shared the identical old logic, so I applied the same helper there for consistency. The helper accepts an `undefined` active tab since this component derives it from the route.

This satisfies all five requirements in the spec: full preservation between traces tabs, and time-range-only preservation for every cross-group navigation (traces↔non-traces and non-traces↔non-traces).

`yarn type-check` passes. I did not touch anything under `tests/` — the existing sidebar tests encode the old behavior and will be updated by the verification patch.
